content.title: Anaemia confirmed
content.body: Your lab report shows haemoglobin of 9.2 g/dL. This definitely confirms that you have anaemia (a low red blood cell level) and no doubt explains your tiredness. A normal range sits above 12. This is a screening signal. Please see a doctor within 7 days to discuss treatment options.
recommendations: Book a doctor visit within 7 days.
Bring the lab report to the appointment.
